---
title: "Outcomes: attending an over-demanded school, graduation and college outcomes"
output: html_document
params:
  data_dir: !r file.path(ifelse(Sys.getenv("USERPROFILE") != "", Sys.getenv("USERPROFILE"), path.expand("~")), "Dropbox", "Effect SAE on SUA", "data", "finalized_design_v1", "outcomes")
  out_dir: "output"
---

This notebook writes every table of the paper's outcomes section and of its appendix, on design K of the over-demanded schools,
in the paper's folder layout under `out_dir`: Table III (`tables/results/lottery_balance.tex`), Table IV
(`tables/results/lottery_college.tex`) and Appendix Tables C.1 to C.6 (`tables/lottery_sample_construction.tex`,
`tables/results/lottery_characteristics.tex`, `tables/complier_alternatives.tex`, `tables/results/lottery_college_offer.tex`,
`tables/results/lottery_college_first_choice.tex`, `tables/lottery_followup.tex`). It also writes `numbers/outcomes_estimates.csv`
(every estimate at full precision), `numbers/outcomes_text_numbers.csv` (each number the outcomes section and its appendix quote, one
row per number, named as the text's macro), `tables/outcomes_text_macros.tex` (the same numbers as the LaTeX macros the paper's text
prints; shares are plain numbers, the text adds the percent sign; the years stay typed) and `numbers/outcomes_text_claims.csv` (each
statement the text makes about these results, with whether it holds). It reads the five files of its data folder (`data_dir`; by default the shared data
folder), each checked against `data_manifest.csv` beside this notebook; a relative `data_dir` or `out_dir` is taken from the notebook's
folder. It needs fixest 0.14.2 or later. Render it with
`rmarkdown::render("outcomes.Rmd", params = list(data_dir = <the data folder>, out_dir = <the output folder>))`; the defaults read the
shared folder and write `output/` next to the notebook.

The two enrollment rows of Tables IV, C.4 and C.5 classify each child by her first higher-education record after the application
year: an enrollment in DEMRE's file D puts her in SUA; any higher-education registry row without a matching DEMRE enrollment, coded or
uncoded, puts her outside SUA; the earlier record decides, and a same-year pair counts in SUA. "Enrolled anywhere" is being in either
row; each child is in at most one.

```{r setup, error = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(fixest)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = FALSE)   # a failed check stops the knit
KNIT_START <- Sys.time() - 2           # the chunk outputs checks that this knit wrote every output (two seconds for a file system's coarse clock)
if (getRversion() != "4.5.1") message("R ", getRversion(), " is not 4.5.1, the version this notebook's numbers come from")
# fixest 0.14.2 or later: it gives the heteroskedasticity-robust SEs the tables print (OLS with the N/(N-K) factor; 2SLS with
# ssc(K.adj = FALSE), without it); earlier versions can differ (0.12.1 keeps a factor n/(n-1))
if (packageVersion("fixest") < "0.14.2") stop("fixest 0.14.2 or later is required (this is ", packageVersion("fixest"), "): earlier versions compute a different robust SE")
if (packageVersion("fixest") > "0.14.2") message("fixest ", packageVersion("fixest"), " is newer than 0.14.2, the version this notebook's numbers come from")

if (!exists("params")) stop("params is missing: render the notebook with rmarkdown::render(), or knit it with a list params in its environment (README)")
# the notebook's own folder: data_manifest.csv is read from it, and a relative data_dir or out_dir is taken from it, whatever the folder the
# chunks run in (RStudio's Knit Directory); when the chunks are run one by one outside a knit, the working directory, which must hold the notebook
knitting <- !is.null(knitr::current_input())
nb_dir <- if (knitting) dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)) else normalizePath(".", winslash = "/")
if (!knitting && !file.exists(file.path(nb_dir, "outcomes.Rmd"))) stop("the notebook's folder is not known: knit outcomes.Rmd, or set the working directory to its folder")
is_absolute <- function(p) grepl("^(~|/|\\\\|[A-Za-z]:[/\\\\])", p)   # a full path (a drive, a root, a network share or the home folder)
stopifnot("is_absolute self-test" = identical(is_absolute(c("C:/a", "c:\\a", "/a", "\\\\server\\a", "~/a", "output", "./a", "a/b", "C:a")),
                                              c(TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE)))
from_notebook <- function(p) if (is_absolute(p)) path.expand(p) else file.path(nb_dir, p)
data_dir <- from_notebook(params$data_dir)   # the data folder
out_dir <- from_notebook(params$out_dir)     # the output folder ("output" beside the notebook by default)
manifest_file <- file.path(nb_dir, "data_manifest.csv")
# the five inputs, every one required, each at the bytes and MD5 of data_manifest.csv beside this notebook; the data folder's own
# data_manifest.csv must list the same files and MD5s
inputs <- c(panel = "outcomes_panel.rds", applications = "outcomes_applications.rds", entrants = "outcomes_entrants.rds",
            group = "outcomes_group.rds", note_counts = "outcomes_note_counts.rds")
if (!file.exists(manifest_file)) stop("data_manifest.csv is missing beside the notebook (", nb_dir, ")")
if (!dir.exists(data_dir)) stop("the data folder is missing: ", data_dir)
missing_files <- setdiff(c(inputs, "data_manifest.csv"), list.files(data_dir))
if (length(missing_files)) stop("missing in the data folder ", data_dir, ": ", paste(missing_files, collapse = ", "))
on_disk <- local({
  read_manifest <- function(f) read.csv(f, colClasses = c(file = "character", bytes = "numeric", md5 = "character"))
  manifest <- read_manifest(manifest_file)
  stopifnot("data_manifest.csv lists the five inputs, each once" = setequal(manifest$file, inputs) && !anyDuplicated(manifest$file),
            "the data folder's data_manifest.csv must be the one beside the notebook" = identical(read_manifest(file.path(data_dir, "data_manifest.csv")), manifest))
  m <- match(inputs, manifest$file)
  d <- data.frame(file = unname(inputs), bytes = file.size(file.path(data_dir, inputs)), md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(data_dir, inputs))))
  differ <- d$file[d$bytes != manifest$bytes[m] | d$md5 != manifest$md5[m]]
  if (length(differ)) stop("inputs that differ from data_manifest.csv: ", paste(differ, collapse = ", "))
  d
})
on_disk

panel <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, inputs[["panel"]]))                 # one row per applicant child
applications <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, inputs[["applications"]]))   # one row per application of the population (Table C.1; the placements footnote)
entrants <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, inputs[["entrants"]]))           # one row per entry at the over-demanded schools (Table C.2's column (3))
group <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, inputs[["group"]]))                 # the over-demanded schools, one row each
note_counts <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, inputs[["note_counts"]]))     # Table IV's note: DEMRE's validation and recognition completers
n_over_demanded <- nrow(group)
stopifnot("the over-demanded schools, each once" = !anyNA(group$RBD) && !anyDuplicated(group$RBD),
          "one count of validation and recognition completers" = nrow(note_counts) == 1L && !is.na(note_counts$validation_completers),
          "Table IV's note: these completers count as not graduated" = isTRUE(note_counts$not_graduated_ever == note_counts$validation_completers),
          "one row per child" = !anyDuplicated(panel$MRUN),
          "the design's columns are complete" = !anyNA(panel[c("YEAR", "CHANCE_GROUP", "LOTTERY_SAMPLE", "LOTTERY_SAMPLE_THOUSANDTHS", "OFFER", "D_OD",
                                                               "FIRST_CHOICE_SAMPLE", "ENTRY_SCHOOL_TYPE")]),
          "each chance group is a whole number from 0 to 100" = all(panel$CHANCE_GROUP %in% 0:100),
          "the offer is a main-stage placement at one of the over-demanded schools" =
            all(applications$RBD_ADMITIDO %in% c(NA, group$RBD)) && identical(panel$OFFER, as.integer(!is.na(applications$RBD_ADMITIDO[applications$KEPT]))),
          "attendance is the entry-year enrollment at one of the over-demanded schools" = identical(panel$D_OD, as.integer(panel$ENTRY_RBD %in% group$RBD)),
          "attendance and the entry school's type agree" = identical(panel$D_OD == 1L, panel$ENTRY_SCHOOL_TYPE == "over_demanded"))
message(sprintf("over-demanded schools %d; children %s; validation and recognition completers %d", n_over_demanded,
                format(nrow(panel), big.mark = ","), note_counts$validation_completers))
dir.create(file.path(out_dir, "tables", "results"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir, "numbers"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

setFixest_vcov(all = "hetero")            # robust SEs; OLS with the N/(N-K) factor and t(N-K) p-values, as Stata's robust
setFixest_estimation(fixef.rm = "none")   # keep chance groups that hold a single child

controls <- c("GPA8_Z", "ES_MUJER", "PRIORITARIO", "ALTO", "ORIGIN_OD")
years <- paste0(min(panel$YEAR), "--", max(panel$YEAR))   # the application years

college <- c(
  GRAD     = "Graduated from high school",
  GRAD_REGULAR = "\\quad Through regular secondary education",
  GRAD_ADULT   = "\\quad Through adult secondary education",
  APPLIED  = "Applied to a college program",
  ASSIGNED = "Assigned a college seat",
  ANYWHERE = "Enrolled anywhere",
  INSUA    = "\\quad First enrollment in SUA",
  OUTSIDE  = "\\quad First enrollment outside SUA"
)

# Enrolled anywhere: in either enrollment row, the child's first enrollment in SUA or outside it; each child is in at most one row.
# The panel's columns are missing for the children without the outcomes; flag() checks them on each estimation sample (the college and
# first-choice chunks)
invisible(lapply(c("OT", "EVER"), function(h) {
  s <- panel[[paste0("INSUA_", h)]]; o <- panel[[paste0("OUTSIDE_", h)]]
  stopifnot("the two enrollment rows present or missing together" = identical(is.na(s), is.na(o)),
            "the enrollment rows are 0/1 integers" = is.integer(s) && is.integer(o) && all(c(s, o) %in% c(0L, 1L, NA)),
            "each child in at most one enrollment row" = all(s + o <= 1L, na.rm = TRUE))
}))
panel <- mutate(panel, ANYWHERE_OT = INSUA_OT + OUTSIDE_OT, ANYWHERE_EVER = INSUA_EVER + OUTSIDE_EVER)

# the windows of the panel's on-time outcomes and the last year of the records (Table C.6 and the notes of Tables C.4 and C.6)
ON_TIME_GRADUATION <- 4L       # graduation by the fourth school year after the application year
ON_TIME_COLLEGE <- 5L          # college outcomes by the admission process five years after it
LAST_SCHOOL_YEAR <- 2025L      # the year-end school records run through the 2025 school year
LAST_COLLEGE_PROCESS <- 2026L  # the college admission and higher-education enrollment records run through 2026

stars <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.01, "$^{***}$", ifelse(p < 0.05, "$^{**}$", ifelse(p < 0.1, "$^{*}$", "")))
num <- function(x, d) sub("^-(0\\.0+)$", "\\1", sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f"), x))   # never "-0.00"
comma <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
tex_row <- function(label, cells) paste0("      ", label, " & ", paste(cells, collapse = " & "), "\\\\\n")

# a constructed 0/1 flag: its share printed; it stops unless the flag takes both values
flag <- function(x, what) {
  if (anyNA(x) || !all(x %in% 0:1) || n_distinct(x) != 2L) stop(what, ": a 0/1 flag taking both values expected")
  message(sprintf("%s: share %.4f of %s", what, mean(x), comma(length(x))))
  invisible(x)
}

# a table file under out_dir, at the path the paper inputs, with this notebook's name on its first line; it stops on a missing or infinite number
no_missing <- function(tex) !any(grepl("(^|[^A-Za-z])(NA|NaN|Inf)([^A-Za-z]|$)", tex))
stopifnot("no_missing self-test" = no_missing("x & 1.00 & (0.39) DEMRE's NAME Info") && !no_missing("x & NA\\\\") && !no_missing("-Inf") && !no_missing("{NaN}"))
write_tex <- function(tex, file) {
  if (!no_missing(tex)) stop(file, ": a missing or infinite number")
  cat("% Generated by outcomes.Rmd\n", tex, file = file.path(out_dir, file), sep = "")
}

# coefficient on the instrument z (OLS) or on attendance (2SLS), SE, p-value and N, one row per model, the models' dependent
# variables y in their order (checked); 2SLS p-values from the normal distribution, as ivreg2's
effect <- function(fit, y, z = "OFFER") {
  models <- if (inherits(fit, "fixest_multi")) as.list(fit) else list(fit)
  stopifnot(identical(unname(map_chr(models, function(m) deparse(m$fml[[2]]))), y))   # each model's dependent variable is its label
  bind_rows(map(models, function(m) {
    iv <- isTRUE(m$is_iv)
    term <- if (iv) "fit_D_OD" else z
    p <- if (iv) 2 * pnorm(-abs(tstat(m)[[term]])) else pvalue(m)[[term]]
    tibble(est = coef(m)[[term]], se = se(m)[[term]], p = p, n = nobs(m))
  }))
}

# the rows of an outcome table (Tables IV, C.4 and C.5): each outcome's mean without the offer and its effect, on time and ever, in pp
outcome_body <- function(est) {
  map_chr(names(college), function(k) {
    ot <- filter(est, var == paste0(k, "_OT"))
    ever <- filter(est, var == paste0(k, "_EVER"))
    stopifnot(nrow(ot) == 1L, nrow(ever) == 1L)   # each outcome's row on time and ever, once
    paste0(
      tex_row(college[[k]], c(num(100 * ot$mean, 2), paste0(num(100 * ot$est, 2), stars(ot$p)),
                              num(100 * ever$mean, 2), paste0(num(100 * ever$est, 2), stars(ever$p)))),
      tex_row("", c("", paste0("(", num(100 * ot$se, 2), ")"), "", paste0("(", num(100 * ever$se, 2), ")")))
    )
  })
}

# the notes' sentence on the enrollment block (Tables IV, C.4 and C.5)
ENROLLMENT_NOTE <- paste0("Enrolled anywhere counts the students who enrolled in any higher-education institution; the two rows indented under ",
                          "it divide these students by where they first enrolled, and a student who first enrolled through and outside SUA in ",
                          "the same year counts in the SUA row.")
```

# Table III: balance and enrollment

Each row's variable is regressed on the offer, with the column's fixed effects.

```{r balance}
lottery <- panel %>%
  filter(LOTTERY_SAMPLE) %>%
  mutate(ANY_SCHOOL = flag(as.integer(!is.na(ENTRY_RBD)), "ANY_SCHOOL"))   # enrolled at any school in the entry year
lottery_1000 <- filter(lottery, LOTTERY_SAMPLE_THOUSANDTHS)
stopifnot("each chance group of Table III's columns (3) and (4) holds a child with an offer and one without" =
            all(tapply(lottery$OFFER, lottery$CHANCE_GROUP, n_distinct) == 2L) &&
            all(tapply(lottery_1000$OFFER, lottery_1000$CHANCE_GROUP_THOUSANDTHS, n_distinct) == 2L))

rows2 <- tribble(
  ~var,          ~panel, ~label,                         ~label2,                             ~scale, ~digits,
  "N_CLASS",     "A",    "Choices ranked",               "",                                  1,      3,
  "N_OD",        "A",    "Over-demanded schools ranked", "",                                  1,      3,
  "FC_OD",       "A",    "Ranked an over-demanded",      "\\quad school first (\\%)",         100,    2,
  "GPA8_Z",      "B",    "8th-grade average (SD)",       "",                                  1,      3,
  "ES_MUJER",    "B",    "Female (\\%)",                 "",                                  100,    2,
  "PRIORITARIO", "B",    "Low-income (\\%)",             "",                                  100,    2,
  "ALTO",        "B",    "Top 20\\% of the school's",    "\\quad grade ranking (\\%)",        100,    2,
  "ORIGIN_OD",   "B",    "Enrolled at an over-demanded", "\\quad school in 8th grade (\\%)",  100,    2,
  "D_OD",        "C",    "Attends an over-demanded",     "\\quad school (\\%)",               100,    2,
  "ANY_SCHOOL",  "C",    "Enrolled at any school (\\%)", "",                                  100,    2
)
balance_vars <- rows2$var[rows2$panel != "C"]   # the eight rows of the joint test

fits2 <- list(
  feols(.[rows2$var] ~ OFFER | YEAR, lottery),
  feols(.[rows2$var] ~ OFFER + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP, lottery),
  feols(.[rows2$var] ~ OFFER + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP_THOUSANDTHS, lottery_1000)
)
est2 <- map(fits2, effect, y = rows2$var)
mean2 <- colMeans(lottery[lottery$OFFER == 0, rows2$var], na.rm = TRUE)
stopifnot(all(panel$ALTO[panel$YEAR == 2016] == 0))   # the notes: the top-20% indicator, not recorded in 2016, is 0 for its applicants
no_gpa <- rows2$var != "GPA8_Z"
stopifnot("Table III: every row but the 8th-grade average covers every child of its column (the N row)" =
            all(est2[[1L]]$n[no_gpa] == nrow(lottery), est2[[2L]]$n[no_gpa] == nrow(lottery), est2[[3L]]$n[no_gpa] == nrow(lottery_1000)))

# joint F as in Abdulkadiroglu et al. (2017): Stata's mvreg, then test; on the children with all eight rows
joint_test <- function(d, rhs) {
  d <- drop_na(d, all_of(balance_vars))
  fit <- feols(as.formula(paste(".[balance_vars] ~ OFFER", rhs)), d)
  z <- resid(feols(as.formula(paste("OFFER ~ 1", rhs)), d))
  b <- coef(fit)[, "OFFER"]
  e <- resid(fit)
  df <- nobs(fit[[1]]) - fit[[1]]$nparams
  V <- crossprod(e) / df / sum(z^2)   # covariance of the eight coefficients
  f_stat <- drop(b %*% solve(V, b)) / length(b)
  tibble(F = f_stat, df = df, p = pf(f_stat, length(b), df, lower.tail = FALSE), n = nrow(d))
}
joint2 <- bind_rows(
  joint_test(lottery, "| YEAR"),
  joint_test(lottery, "+ i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP"),
  joint_test(lottery_1000, "+ i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP_THOUSANDTHS")
)
as.data.frame(joint2)
```

```{r balance-tex}
body2 <- map_chr(seq_len(nrow(rows2)), function(i) {
  r <- rows2[i, ]
  cells <- map_chr(est2, function(e) paste0(num(r$scale * e$est[i], r$digits), stars(e$p[i])))
  ses <- map_chr(est2, function(e) paste0("(", num(r$scale * e$se[i], r$digits), ")"))
  paste0(tex_row(r$label, c(num(r$scale * mean2[[r$var]], r$digits), cells)),
         tex_row(r$label2, c("", ses)))
})
with_gpa <- comma(c(sum(lottery$OFFER == 0 & !is.na(lottery$GPA8_Z)), joint2$n))

note2 <- paste0(
  "Notes: The sample is the lottery sample of Section~\\ref{sec:lottery-data}. Column (1) is the mean among students without an offer. ",
  "Columns (2) to (4) report the coefficient on the offer in a regression of the row's variable on the offer, with heteroskedasticity-robust ",
  "standard errors in parentheses, and differ in what they hold fixed: column (2) the application year only; columns (3) and (4) the chance ",
  "group (the chance rounded to the nearest hundredth or thousandth) and the application year, on the students whose group holds a ",
  "student with an offer and a student without one. The joint test is the $F$-test that the coefficients of the eight rows of Panels A ",
  "and B are jointly zero in a multivariate regression of those rows on the offer with the column's fixed effects. The 8th-grade ",
  "average row and the joint test cover the students with that average: ", with_gpa[1], ", ", with_gpa[2], ", ", with_gpa[3],
  ", and ", with_gpa[4], " in columns (1) to (4). Rows marked \\% report a share in column (1) and a difference ",
  "in pp in columns (2) to (4). Choices ranked counts the choices the student ranked: a school, or a classroom at a school with more ",
  "than one 9th-grade classroom. Over-demanded schools ranked counts the distinct over-demanded schools among them. The top-20\\% ",
  "indicator is not recorded in the 2016 process and is set to 0 for its applicants. Panel C refers to the annual enrollment census ",
  "of the entry year. $^{***}$p$<$0.01, $^{**}$p$<$0.05, $^{*}$p$<$0.1."
)

tex2 <- paste0(
  "\\begin{table}[htbp]\\singlespacing\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.0}\n",
  "   \\caption{Lottery Balance and Enrollment, Application Years ", years, "}\\label{tab: lottery balance}\n",
  "   \\centerline{\\scalebox{0.85}{\\begin{tabular}{lcccc}\n",
  "      \\toprule\n",
  "                   & No offer & No & \\multicolumn{2}{c}{Chance-group controls}\\\\\n",
  "      \\cmidrule(lr){4-5}\n",
  "                   & mean & controls & Hundredths & Thousandths\\\\\n",
  "                   & (1) & (2) & (3) & (4)\\\\\n",
  "      \\midrule\n",
  "      \\multicolumn{5}{l}{\\textit{Panel A. Ranked list}}\\\\\n",
  paste(body2[rows2$panel == "A"], collapse = ""),
  "      \\midrule\n",
  "      \\multicolumn{5}{l}{\\textit{Panel B. Characteristics}}\\\\\n",
  paste(body2[rows2$panel == "B"], collapse = ""),
  "      \\midrule\n",
  "      \\multicolumn{5}{l}{\\textit{Panel C. Enrollment in the entry year}}\\\\\n",
  paste(body2[rows2$panel == "C"], collapse = ""),
  "      \\midrule\n",
  tex_row("$N$", comma(c(sum(lottery$OFFER == 0), nrow(lottery), nrow(lottery), nrow(lottery_1000)))),
  tex_row("Chance groups", c("", "", comma(n_distinct(lottery$CHANCE_GROUP)), comma(n_distinct(lottery_1000$CHANCE_GROUP_THOUSANDTHS)))),
  tex_row("$F$-test for joint significance", c("", num(joint2$F, 2))),
  tex_row("$p$-value", c("", num(joint2$p, 3))),
  "      \\bottomrule\n",
  "   \\end{tabular}}}\n",
  "   \\par\\smallskip{\\scriptsize ", note2, "}\n",
  "\\end{table}\n"
)
write_tex(tex2, "tables/results/lottery_balance.tex")
cat(tex2)
```

# Table IV: graduation and college outcomes

Each outcome is regressed on attendance at an over-demanded school by 2SLS, with the offer as the instrument.

```{r college}
sample3 <- drop_na(lottery, all_of(controls)) %>%
  mutate(ANYWHERE_OT = flag(ANYWHERE_OT, "ANYWHERE_OT (Table IV's sample)"),
         ANYWHERE_EVER = flag(ANYWHERE_EVER, "ANYWHERE_EVER (Table IV's sample)"))   # Enrolled anywhere
vars3 <- c(paste0(names(college), "_OT"), paste0(names(college), "_EVER"))

# on an estimation sample: every outcome is a complete 0/1 flag (Enrolled anywhere, the sum of its two rows, included), and the two rows
# indented under graduation divide it
outcomes_ok <- function(d) {
  x <- as.matrix(d[vars3])
  stopifnot("every outcome is a complete 0/1 flag" = !anyNA(x) && all(x %in% 0:1))
  for (h in c("_OT", "_EVER")) {
    stopifnot("the two graduation rows divide graduation" = identical(d[[paste0("GRAD", h)]], d[[paste0("GRAD_REGULAR", h)]] + d[[paste0("GRAD_ADULT", h)]]))
  }
  invisible(d)
}
outcomes_ok(sample3)
stopifnot("each chance group of Table IV's sample holds a child with an offer and one without" =
            all(tapply(sample3$OFFER, sample3$CHANCE_GROUP, n_distinct) == 2L))

first_stage <- feols(D_OD ~ OFFER + .[controls] + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP, sample3)
fit3 <- feols(.[vars3] ~ .[controls] + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP | D_OD ~ OFFER, sample3,
              ssc = ssc(K.adj = FALSE))   # 2SLS SEs without the N/(N-K) factor, as ivreg2's robust
fs3 <- effect(first_stage, "D_OD")
est3 <- effect(fit3, vars3) %>%
  mutate(var = vars3, mean = colMeans(sample3[sample3$OFFER == 0, vars3]))
stopifnot("Table IV: every row and the first stage cover every child of the N row" = all(est3$n == nrow(sample3), fs3$n == nrow(sample3)))
```

```{r college-tex}
note3 <- paste0(
  "Notes: The sample is the ", comma(nrow(sample3)), " students of the lottery sample with every characteristic of ",
  "Section~\\ref{sec:lottery-data}. Columns (2) and (4) report 2SLS estimates of the effect of attending an over-demanded school, with ",
  "the offer as the instrument, chance-group and application-year fixed effects, and the characteristics as controls ",
  "(Section~\\ref{sec:lottery-estimation}); the first stage is ", num(100 * fs3$est, 2), " pp (", num(100 * fs3$se, 2), "). Columns (1) ",
  "and (3) are means among the students without an offer, in \\%; the effects are in pp. Heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors in ",
  "parentheses. On time and ever are defined in Section~\\ref{sec:lottery-data}. A student who completes secondary school in adult ",
  "education counts as graduated; the two rows indented under graduation divide it by route, and a student who also completes twelfth ",

)
```

# Appendix Table C.2: the children whose attendance depends on the offer

Column (1) is the 2SLS of $X(D - 1/2)$ on attendance, the offer the instrument, with the chance groups as fixed effects and each child
weighted by $1/(p_c(1 - p_c))$, $p_c$ the offer share of her chance group among the row's children, so that every child whose
attendance depends on the offer counts once; heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors without the N/(N-K) factor. Columns (2) and (3)
are means.

```{r characteristics}
rows_c2 <- rows2[rows2$panel == "B", ]   # the five characteristics, as Table III's Panel B
col1 <- bind_rows(map(rows_c2$var, function(v) {
  d <- lottery %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[v]])) %>%
    group_by(CHANCE_GROUP) %>%
    mutate(W = 1 / (mean(OFFER) * (1 - mean(OFFER)))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(X = as.numeric(.data[[v]]), Y = X * (D_OD - 0.5))
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(d$W)))   # each chance group holds a child with an offer and one without, among the row's children
  fit <- feols(Y ~ 1 | CHANCE_GROUP | D_OD ~ OFFER, d, weights = ~W, ssc = ssc(K.adj = FALSE))
  mutate(effect(fit, "Y"), var = v, mean_all = mean(d$X))
}))

# column (3): the entries; low income is SAE's flag with a main-stage application and the SEP roster of the entry year without one
entrants3 <- mutate(entrants, LOW_INCOME = if_else(MAIN_STAGE_9, PRIORITARIO, LOW_INCOME_SEP_ENTRY_YEAR))
entrant_cols <- c(GPA8_Z = "GPA8_Z", ES_MUJER = "FEMALE", PRIORITARIO = "LOW_INCOME", ALTO = "ALTO", ORIGIN_OD = "ORIGIN_OD")
col3 <- bind_rows(map(names(entrant_cols), function(v) {
  x <- entrants3[[entrant_cols[[v]]]]
  tibble(var = v, mean3 = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), n3 = sum(!is.na(x)))
}))
overlap <- filter(entrants, MRUN %in% lottery$MRUN)   # every entry of a child of column (2)
stopifnot(max(table(entrants$MRUN)) == 2L)   # no child enters more than twice: the entries less the children count those who entered twice
c2_counts <- c(twice = nrow(entrants) - n_distinct(entrants$MRUN), overlap_entries = nrow(overlap),
               overlap_children = n_distinct(overlap$MRUN), fill = sum(!entrants$MAIN_STAGE_9), main_stage = sum(entrants$MAIN_STAGE_9),
               eighth_grade = sum(!is.na(entrants$ORIGIN_OD)))
stopifnot(identical(col1$var, rows_c2$var), identical(col3$var, rows_c2$var),   # the three columns in the rows' order
          c2_counts[["main_stage"]] == col3$n3[col3$var == "ALTO"], c2_counts[["eighth_grade"]] == col3$n3[col3$var == "ORIGIN_OD"],
          "Table C.2's note: every row but the 8th-grade average covers all of column (2); female and low-income cover all of column (3)" =
            all(col1$n[col1$var != "GPA8_Z"] == nrow(lottery)) && all(col3$n3[col3$var %in% c("ES_MUJER", "PRIORITARIO")] == nrow(entrants)))
as.data.frame(left_join(col1, col3, by = "var"))
c2_counts
```

```{r characteristics-tex}
body_c2 <- map_chr(seq_len(nrow(rows_c2)), function(i) {
  r <- rows_c2[i, ]
  paste0(tex_row(r$label, c(num(r$scale * col1$est[i], r$digits), num(r$scale * col1$mean_all[i], r$digits),
                            num(r$scale * col3$mean3[i], r$digits))),
         tex_row(r$label2, c(paste0("(", num(r$scale * col1$se[i], r$digits), ")"), "", "")))
})

note_c2 <- paste0(
  "Notes: Column (1) reports the mean of each characteristic among the students of column (2) whose attendance depends on the offer, ",
  "estimated from all the students of column (2) by 2SLS with the offer as the instrument and chance-group fixed effects, each student ",
  "weighted so that every student whose attendance depends on the offer counts once, as in the semiparametric estimator of ",
  "\\citet[p.~1402]{abdulkadiroglu2017}, which follows \\citet{abadie2003semiparametric}; heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors in ",
  "parentheses. Columns (2) and (3) report means. Column (2) is the lottery sample of Section~\\ref{sec:lottery-data}. Column (3) covers ",
  "the 9th-grade entrants of the ", comma(n_over_demanded), " schools (Section~\\ref{sec:allocation}) from the first class SAE assigned ",
  "in the school's region through ", max(entrants$YEAR) + 1L, "; a student who entered two of these classes (", comma(c2_counts[["twice"]]),
  " students) counts at each entry, and ", comma(c2_counts[["overlap_entries"]]), " of these entries belong to ",
  comma(c2_counts[["overlap_children"]]), " students of column (2). Each characteristic is defined as in Section~\\ref{sec:lottery-data}, ",
  "from the records of the year before entry; for the ", comma(c2_counts[["fill"]]), " entrants of column (3) without a main-stage ",
  "application that year, the female row takes the sex in the Ministry of Education's enrollment record of the entry year, and the ",
  "low-income row prioritario status in the entry year from the annual SEP roster, as in Section~\\ref{sec:allocation}. Each row covers ",
  "the students with that characteristic: for the 8th-grade average, ", comma(col1$n[col1$var == "GPA8_Z"]), " students in columns (1) ",

)
```

# Appendix Table C.3: where the children whose attendance depends on the offer go without it

Each share is minus the 2SLS effect of attendance on 1[the entry school's type] x (1 - attendance), specified as in Table IV
(Abdulkadiroglu et al. 2017, Table VII).

```{r complier-destinations}
destinations <- c(publicly_funded_outside = "Other publicly funded school", fee_paying = "Fee-paying private school",
                  no_record = "No entry-year enrollment record")
sample_c3 <- mutate(sample3,
                    PUBLIC = flag((ENTRY_SCHOOL_TYPE == "publicly_funded_outside") * (1L - D_OD), "PUBLIC"),
                    FEE = flag((ENTRY_SCHOOL_TYPE == "fee_paying") * (1L - D_OD), "FEE"),
                    NONE = flag((ENTRY_SCHOOL_TYPE == "no_record") * (1L - D_OD), "NONE"))
fit_c3 <- feols(c(PUBLIC, FEE, NONE) ~ .[controls] + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP | D_OD ~ OFFER, sample_c3,
                ssc = ssc(K.adj = FALSE))
est_c3 <- effect(fit_c3, c("PUBLIC", "FEE", "NONE")) %>%
  mutate(type = names(destinations), share = -est)
stopifnot(abs(sum(est_c3$share) - 1) < 1e-8)   # without the offer, every such child is in one of the three
stopifnot("Table C.3: every row covers every child of Table IV's sample" = all(est_c3$n == nrow(sample3)))
as.data.frame(est_c3)

tex_c3 <- c(
```

# Appendix Table C.4: the offer's effect

Each outcome is regressed on the offer by OLS, with Table IV's sample, controls and fixed effects.

```{r offer-effect}
fit_c4 <- feols(.[vars3] ~ OFFER + .[controls] + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP, sample3)
est_c4 <- effect(fit_c4, vars3) %>%
  mutate(var = vars3, mean = colMeans(sample3[sample3$OFFER == 0, vars3]))
stopifnot("Table C.4: every row covers every child of the N row" = all(est_c4$n == nrow(sample3)),
          "each Table IV estimate is its offer effect divided by the first stage (the outcomes section's text on the estimation)" =
            identical(est_c4$var, est3$var) && max(abs(est3$est - est_c4$est / fs3$est)) < 1e-8)
# the estimator's arithmetic on the data of record: a later fixest with other defaults would move these SEs and F statistics, and the
# knit stops here
if (on_disk$md5[on_disk$file == inputs[["panel"]]] == "2402d24e51204816f0346855a616a38e") {
  stopifnot("Table IV's first robust SE as of record (2SLS, without the N/(N-K) factor)" = abs(est3$se[est3$var == "GRAD_OT"] - 0.0033514252152544565) < 1e-9,
            "Table C.4's first robust SE as of record (OLS, with the N/(N-K) factor)" = abs(est_c4$se[est_c4$var == "GRAD_OT"] - 0.0020438709615003977) < 1e-9,
            "Table III's three joint F statistics as of record (their degrees of freedom count fixest's parameters)" =
              max(abs(joint2$F / c(1760.7045540770171, 0.8638523994141537, 0.93060616746334546) - 1)) < 1e-9,
            "Table C.2's first robust SE as of record (weighted 2SLS, without the N/(N-K) factor)" =
              abs(col1$se[col1$var == "GPA8_Z"] / 0.015461133978172052 - 1) < 1e-9)
} else message("the panel is another panel than the one of record: the standard errors and F statistics of record are not checked")
```

# Appendix Table C.5: first-choice admission lotteries

Table IV's 2SLS with a first-choice offer as the instrument and one fixed effect per first-choice admission lottery, on the children
of the first-choice sample with every characteristic, in or outside the lottery sample.

```{r first-choice}
first_choice <- panel %>%
  filter(FIRST_CHOICE_SAMPLE) %>%
  drop_na(all_of(controls)) %>%
  mutate(ANYWHERE_OT = flag(ANYWHERE_OT, "ANYWHERE_OT (first-choice sample)"),
         ANYWHERE_EVER = flag(ANYWHERE_EVER, "ANYWHERE_EVER (first-choice sample)"))   # Enrolled anywhere
outcomes_ok(first_choice)
first_stage_c5 <- feols(D_OD ~ FIRST_CHOICE_OFFER + .[controls] | FIRST_CHOICE_LOTTERY, first_choice)
fit_c5 <- feols(.[vars3] ~ .[controls] | FIRST_CHOICE_LOTTERY | D_OD ~ FIRST_CHOICE_OFFER, first_choice,
                ssc = ssc(K.adj = FALSE))
fs_c5 <- effect(first_stage_c5, "D_OD", z = "FIRST_CHOICE_OFFER")
est_c5 <- effect(fit_c5, vars3) %>%
  mutate(var = vars3, mean = colMeans(first_choice[first_choice$FIRST_CHOICE_OFFER == 0, vars3]))
stopifnot("Table C.5: every row and the first stage cover every child of the N row" = all(est_c5$n == nrow(first_choice), fs_c5$n == nrow(first_choice)))
print(c(children = nrow(first_choice), lotteries = n_distinct(first_choice$FIRST_CHOICE_LOTTERY)))
print(c(first_stage_pp = 100 * fs_c5$est, se_pp = 100 * fs_c5$se))
```

# Appendix Table C.6: the outcome horizons by application year

```{r followup}
followup <- tibble(YEAR = sort(unique(panel$YEAR))) %>%
  mutate(graduation = YEAR + ON_TIME_GRADUATION, process = YEAR + ON_TIME_COLLEGE, more_years = LAST_SCHOOL_YEAR - graduation)
stopifnot(all(followup$more_years == LAST_COLLEGE_PROCESS - followup$process))   # the same follow-up for graduation and college
# the windows against the outcome columns (the children with every outcome): in the application year with no further follow-up, each
# on-time outcome equals its ever outcome; in the year with one more year of records, each outcome has a child whose ever outcome is above it
observed <- drop_na(panel, all_of(vars3))
no_more <- filter(observed, YEAR == followup$YEAR[followup$more_years == 0])
one_more <- filter(observed, YEAR == followup$YEAR[followup$more_years == 1])
cols_ot <- paste0(names(college), "_OT")
cols_ever <- paste0(names(college), "_EVER")
stopifnot(all(no_more[cols_ot] == no_more[cols_ever]), all(colSums(one_more[cols_ever] > one_more[cols_ot]) > 0))
as.data.frame(followup)

  "\\begin{minipage}{\\textwidth}\\footnotesize",
  paste0("Notes: Scheduled dates assume one grade of progression per year after ninth-grade entry. The final column counts years beyond ",
         "the scheduled horizon through the latest records: ", LAST_SCHOOL_YEAR, " for graduation and ", LAST_COLLEGE_PROCESS, " for ",
         "college outcomes. It describes the observation window, not a restriction to students who graduate or apply on schedule."),
  "\\end{minipage}",
  "\\end{table}"
)
write_tex(paste0(paste(tex_c6, collapse = "\n"), "\n"), "tables/lottery_followup.tex")
cat(tex_c6, sep = "\n")
```

# The numbers of the outcomes section's text and of its appendix's prose

The comments name the paragraph of the outcomes section that quotes each number. The chunk `text-numbers` writes each number the text
quotes, named as the text's macro, and those macros; it stops if one of these numbers comes out missing, empty or infinite. It then
checks each statement the current text makes about these results (a sign, a significance call, a comparison) and writes them with
whether they hold; if a statement does not hold, the knit names it and stops once all are written.

```{r text-counts}
# the sample paragraphs: the over-demanded schools and the children
outside <- filter(panel, !LOTTERY_SAMPLE)   # a chance of 0 or 1
stopifnot("Table C.1's note: every child outside the lottery sample is in chance group 0 or 100" =
            all(outside$CHANCE_GROUP %in% c(0, 100)))
counts <- c(over_demanded_schools = n_over_demanded, applicants = nrow(panel), lottery_sample = nrow(lottery),
            every_characteristic = nrow(sample3), chance_0_or_1 = nrow(outside), chance_0 = sum(outside$CHANCE_GROUP == 0),
            chance_1 = sum(outside$CHANCE_GROUP == 100), offer = sum(lottery$OFFER == 1), no_offer = sum(lottery$OFFER == 0))
counts

# the sample paragraph's footnote on the placements: the 9th-grade main-stage placements at the over-demanded schools in the 2016-2021
# processes; the share with no priority (the regular category), and the schools where a random number decided at least one seat taken
# with no priority: a seat filled by priority tier and random number (every seat but those filled through a school's special-education
# or academic-track ordering, and the guaranteed return of current students)
placements <- filter(applications, !is.na(RBD_ADMITIDO))
no_priority <- filter(placements, PRIORITY_CATEGORY == "regular")
seat_types <- c("2016 pilot list", "S ordering", "S tier and random number", "T ordering", "T tier and random number",
                "A high achiever, random number", "A tier and random number", "D low-income pool", "R regular pool", "G guaranteed return")
stopifnot("every placement has its seat type" = !anyNA(placements$POOL_TYPE),
          "every placement took one of the assignment's ten seat types" = all(placements$POOL_TYPE %in% seat_types))
by_number <- flag(!no_priority$POOL_TYPE %in% c("S ordering", "T ordering", "G guaranteed return"), "by_number")
footnote <- c(placements = nrow(placements), no_priority = nrow(no_priority), share_no_priority = nrow(no_priority) / nrow(placements),
              schools_no_priority = n_distinct(no_priority$RBD_ADMITIDO), schools_random_number = n_distinct(no_priority$RBD_ADMITIDO[by_number]))
footnote[names(footnote) != "share_no_priority"]
c(share_no_priority_pct = 100 * footnote[["share_no_priority"]])

# the balance paragraph: without the offer, the entry-year destinations of the children whose attendance depends on it (Table C.3), in
# % with their SEs
est_c3 %>%
  transmute(type, share_pct = 100 * share, se_pp = 100 * se, n) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# the results paragraphs: the effects (pp) as shares of the means without an offer (%), on time and ever
shares <- est3 %>%
  filter(var %in% c(paste0(c("GRAD", "APPLIED", "ASSIGNED", "INSUA"), "_OT"), paste0(c("GRAD", "ASSIGNED", "INSUA"), "_EVER"))) %>%
  transmute(var, effect_pp = 100 * est, se_pp = 100 * se, p, n, mean_pct = 100 * mean, pct_of_mean = 100 * abs(est) / mean)
as.data.frame(shares)
```

```{r text-numbers}
# the position of the one row whose key is v: it stops unless exactly one row matches (a key that is missing, NA or repeated stops the knit)
one_row <- function(keys, v) { i <- which(keys == v); if (length(i) != 1L) stop(length(i), " rows match ", v); i }
local({   # self-test: a match; a miss, an NA and a repeated key stop
  stops <- function(expr) inherits(tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) e), "error")
  stopifnot("one_row self-test" = one_row(c("a", "b", NA), "b") == 2L && stops(one_row(c("a", "b"), "z")) && stops(one_row(c("a", "b"), NA)) && stops(one_row(c("a", "a"), "a")))
})
t3 <- function(v) est3[one_row(est3$var, v), ]             # Table IV
t2 <- function(v, k) est2[[k]][one_row(rows2$var, v), ]    # Table III, columns (2) to (4)
t4 <- function(v) est_c4[one_row(est_c4$var, v), ]         # Table C.4
t5 <- function(v) est_c5[one_row(est_c5$var, v), ]         # Table C.5
pp <- function(x) num(abs(100 * x), 2)                     # an effect in pp, as the text quotes it (the direction in words)
share_of <- function(v) num(shares$pct_of_mean[one_row(shares$var, v)], 1)   # an effect as a share of its mean without an offer, in %, as the text quotes it
dest <- function(k) num(100 * est_c3$share[one_row(est_c3$type, k)], 1)      # a destination's share, Table C.3, in %
coincide <- followup$YEAR[followup$more_years == 0]   # the application year whose on-time and ever windows coincide
no_alto <- panel %>% group_by(YEAR) %>% summarise(zero = isTRUE(all(ALTO == 0))) %>% filter(zero) %>% pull(YEAR)
stopifnot(length(no_alto) == 1L)   # one application year whose applicants all carry ALTO 0: the process without the top-20% indicator

# every number the outcomes section and its appendix quote, named as the macro the text prints: numbers/outcomes_text_numbers.csv and
# tables/outcomes_text_macros.tex. Shares are plain numbers (the text adds the percent sign); the years stay typed (a statement below checks them)
text_numbers <- tribble(
  ~macro,                            ~value,                                     ~what,
  "OutcomesODSchools",               comma(n_over_demanded),                     "the over-demanded schools",
  "OutcomesLotterySample",           comma(nrow(lottery)),                       "the lottery sample",
  "OutcomesEstimationSample",        comma(nrow(sample3)),                       "the lottery sample with every characteristic",
  "OutcomesNoPriorityShare",         num(100 * footnote[["share_no_priority"]], 1), "the placements with no priority, % of the placements at the over-demanded schools",
  "OutcomesRandomNumberSchools",     comma(footnote[["schools_random_number"]]), "the schools where a random number decided a seat taken with no priority",
  "OutcomesChanceGroups",            comma(n_distinct(lottery$CHANCE_GROUP)),    "the chance groups",
  "OutcomesWithOffer",               comma(sum(lottery$OFFER == 1)),             "the children with an offer",
  "OutcomesWithoutOffer",            comma(sum(lottery$OFFER == 0)),             "the children without an offer",
  "OutcomesBalanceODRanked",         num(t2("N_OD", 1)$est, 3),                  "Table III (2), over-demanded schools ranked",
  "OutcomesBalanceRankedFirst",      num(100 * t2("FC_OD", 1)$est, 2),           "Table III (2), ranked an over-demanded school first, pp",
  "OutcomesFirstStageTableIII",      num(100 * t2("D_OD", 2)$est, 2),            "the first stage, Table III (3), pp",
  "OutcomesFirstStage",              num(100 * fs3$est, 2),                      "the first stage, Table IV's specification, pp",
  "OutcomesAttendanceNoOffer",       num(100 * mean2[["D_OD"]], 2),              "attendance without an offer, Table III (1), %",
  "OutcomesNoOfferPublic",           dest("publicly_funded_outside"),            "Table C.3, other publicly funded school, %",
  "OutcomesNoOfferPrivate",          dest("fee_paying"),                         "Table C.3, fee-paying private school, %",
  "OutcomesNoOfferNoRecord",         dest("no_record"),                          "Table C.3, no enrollment record, %",
  "OutcomesOLSGradOnTime",           pp(t4("GRAD_OT")$est),                      "Table C.4, graduation on time, pp",
  "OutcomesOLSAssignedOnTime",       pp(t4("ASSIGNED_OT")$est),                  "Table C.4, assigned on time, pp",
  "OutcomesOLSEnrolledSUAOnTime",    pp(t4("INSUA_OT")$est),                     "Table C.4, first enrollment in SUA on time, pp",
  "OutcomesGradOnTime",              pp(t3("GRAD_OT")$est),                      "Table IV, graduation on time, pp",
  "OutcomesAppliedOnTime",           pp(t3("APPLIED_OT")$est),                   "Table IV, applied on time, pp",
  "OutcomesAssignedOnTime",          pp(t3("ASSIGNED_OT")$est),                  "Table IV, assigned on time, pp",
  "OutcomesEnrolledSUAOnTime",       pp(t3("INSUA_OT")$est),                     "Table IV, first enrollment in SUA on time, pp",
  "OutcomesGradOnTimeShare",         share_of("GRAD_OT"),                        "graduation on time, % of its mean without an offer",
  "OutcomesAppliedOnTimeShare",      share_of("APPLIED_OT"),                     "applied on time, % of its mean without an offer",
  "OutcomesAssignedOnTimeShare",     share_of("ASSIGNED_OT"),                    "assigned on time, % of its mean without an offer",
  "OutcomesEnrolledSUAOnTimeShare",  share_of("INSUA_OT"),                       "first enrollment in SUA on time, % of its mean without an offer",
  "OutcomesGradRegularOnTime",       pp(t3("GRAD_REGULAR_OT")$est),              "Table IV, graduation through regular secondary education on time, pp",
  "OutcomesGradAdultOnTime",         pp(t3("GRAD_ADULT_OT")$est),                "Table IV, graduation through adult secondary education on time, pp",
  "OutcomesGradEver",                pp(t3("GRAD_EVER")$est),                    "Table IV, graduation ever, pp",
  "OutcomesGradEverShare",           share_of("GRAD_EVER"),                      "graduation ever, % of its mean without an offer",
  "OutcomesAppliedEver",             pp(t3("APPLIED_EVER")$est),                 "Table IV, applied ever, pp",
  "OutcomesAssignedEver",            pp(t3("ASSIGNED_EVER")$est),                "Table IV, assigned ever, pp",
  "OutcomesEnrolledSUAEver",         pp(t3("INSUA_EVER")$est),                   "Table IV, first enrollment in SUA ever, pp",
  "OutcomesAssignedEverShare",       share_of("ASSIGNED_EVER"),                  "assigned ever, % of its mean without an offer",
  "OutcomesEnrolledSUAEverShare",    share_of("INSUA_EVER"),                     "first enrollment in SUA ever, % of its mean without an offer",
  "OutcomesFirstChoiceSample",       comma(nrow(first_choice)),                  "Table C.5's sample",
  "OutcomesFirstChoiceFirstStage",   num(100 * fs_c5$est, 2),                    "Table C.5's first stage, pp",
  "OutcomesFirstChoiceFirstStageSE", num(100 * fs_c5$se, 2),                     "its robust standard error, pp"
)
stopifnot("each macro name is letters only and appears once" = all(grepl("^[A-Za-z]+$", text_numbers$macro)) && !anyDuplicated(text_numbers$macro),
          "every number the text quotes has a value (none missing, empty or infinite)" =
            !anyNA(text_numbers$value) && all(nzchar(text_numbers$value)) && no_missing(text_numbers$value))
write.csv(text_numbers, file.path(out_dir, "numbers", "outcomes_text_numbers.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write_tex(paste0(paste(sprintf("\\newcommand{\\%s}{%s}", text_numbers$macro, text_numbers$value), collapse = "\n"), "\n"), "tables/outcomes_text_macros.tex")
as.data.frame(text_numbers)

# a statement the current text makes about these results, named by the part of the paper that makes it: each is evaluated (an error counts
# as not holding) and written with whether it holds (numbers/outcomes_text_claims.csv); each that does not hold is printed (a sentence of the
# text that moves with these results), and once they are all written the knit stops on it
text_claims <- function(...) {
  labels <- ...names()
  stopifnot("every statement carries its label, each once" = ...length() > 0L && !is.null(labels) && all(nzchar(labels)) && !anyDuplicated(labels))
  holds <- logical(...length())
  for (i in seq_len(...length())) holds[i] <- isTRUE(tryCatch(...elt(i), error = function(e) NA))
  for (s in labels[!holds]) message("a statement of the current text does not hold with these results: ", s)
  tibble(statement = labels, holds = holds)
}
local({   # self-test: a true, a false and an erroring statement are recorded as TRUE, FALSE, FALSE; an unlabelled statement stops
  stops <- function(expr) inherits(tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) e), "error")
  s <- suppressMessages(text_claims("t1" = TRUE, "t2" = FALSE, "t3" = stop("an error")))
  stopifnot("text_claims self-test" = identical(s$holds, c(TRUE, FALSE, FALSE)) && identical(s$statement, c("t1", "t2", "t3")) && stops(text_claims(TRUE)))
})

t2s <- function(k, v) bind_rows(map(v, t2, k = k))    # rows of Table III's column k + 1
t3s <- function(...) bind_rows(map(c(...), t3))       # rows of Table IV
t4s <- function(...) bind_rows(map(c(...), t4))       # rows of Table C.4
t5s <- function(...) bind_rows(map(c(...), t5))       # rows of Table C.5
falls <- function(r) nrow(r) > 0L && all(r$est < 0 & r$p < 0.1)   # negative and statistically significant
null <- function(r) nrow(r) > 0L && all(r$p >= 0.1)               # not statistically significant
shrinks <- function(k) t3(paste0(k, "_EVER"))$est < 0 && abs(t3(paste0(k, "_EVER"))$est) < abs(t3(paste0(k, "_OT"))$est)   # negative ever, smaller than on time
panel_a <- rows2$var[rows2$panel == "A"]
panel_b <- rows2$var[rows2$panel == "B"]
claims <- text_claims(
  "the abstract's, the Introduction's, the mechanisms section's opening and the conclusion's text on Table IV: attending lowers on-time graduation, assignment and enrollment through SUA, each statistically significant" =
    falls(t3s("GRAD_OT", "ASSIGNED_OT", "INSUA_OT")),
  "the abstract's text on Table IV: the losses persist over time (graduation, assignment and enrollment through SUA negative and statistically significant ever)" =
    falls(t3s("GRAD_EVER", "ASSIGNED_EVER", "INSUA_EVER")),
  "the outcomes section's text on Table III: within application years, the students with and without an offer differ in their ranked lists (all three rows of Panel A)" =
    all(t2s(1L, panel_a)$p < 0.1),
  "the outcomes section's text on Table III: within chance groups, none of the eight differences of Panels A and B is statistically significant, individually or jointly, at the hundredth or the thousandth" =
    null(t2s(2L, balance_vars)) && null(t2s(3L, balance_vars)) && all(joint2$p[2:3] >= 0.1),
  "a footnote of the outcomes section on Table III: within application years, students with an offer rank more over-demanded schools and are more likely to rank one first" =
    t2("N_OD", 1L)$est > 0 && t2("FC_OD", 1L)$est > 0,
  "a footnote of the outcomes section on Table III: within application years, the groups differ in four of the five baseline characteristics" =
    sum(t2s(1L, panel_b)$p < 0.1) == 4L,
  "the outcomes section's text on Table III's Panel C: an offer raises attendance, in both specifications, statistically significant at the 1% level (offers are relevant for attendance)" =
    t2("D_OD", 2L)$est > 0 && fs3$est > 0 && t2("D_OD", 2L)$p < 0.01 && fs3$p < 0.01,
  "the outcomes section's and its appendix's text on Table C.3: most students whose attendance depends on the offer enroll in another publicly funded school without it" =
    est_c3$share[est_c3$type == "publicly_funded_outside"] > 0.5,
  "a footnote of the outcomes section and the outcomes appendix's text on Table C.2: these students have a lower 8th-grade average and a larger low-income share than the entrants" =
    col1$est[col1$var == "GPA8_Z"] < col3$mean3[col3$var == "GPA8_Z"] && col1$est[col1$var == "PRIORITARIO"] > col3$mean3[col3$var == "PRIORITARIO"],
  "a footnote of the outcomes section on Table C.4: an offer lowers on-time graduation, assignment and enrollment through SUA, each statistically significant (the effects that remain significant ever)" =
    falls(t4s("GRAD_OT", "ASSIGNED_OT", "INSUA_OT")),
  "a footnote of the outcomes section on Table C.4: the three effects remain negative and statistically significant ever" = falls(t4s("GRAD_EVER", "ASSIGNED_EVER", "INSUA_EVER")),
  "the outcomes section's text on Table IV: attending lowers on-time graduation, application, assignment and enrollment through SUA, all four statistically significant" =
    falls(t3s("GRAD_OT", "APPLIED_OT", "ASSIGNED_OT", "INSUA_OT")),
  "the outcomes section's text on Table IV: on time, graduation through regular secondary education falls and through adult secondary education rises, both statistically significant" =
    falls(t3s("GRAD_REGULAR_OT")) && t3("GRAD_ADULT_OT")$est > 0 && t3("GRAD_ADULT_OT")$p < 0.1,
  "the outcomes section's text on Table IV: the effect on enrollment outside SUA on time is negative and statistically significant" = falls(t3s("OUTSIDE_OT")),
  "the outcomes section's text on Table IV: lost SUA enrollments are not offset outside the system (enrolled anywhere falls on time, statistically significant)" = falls(t3s("ANYWHERE_OT")),
  "the outcomes section's text on Table IV: the graduation decline shrinks with follow-up" = shrinks("GRAD"),
  "the outcomes section's text on Table IV: the decline in college applications shrinks and is statistically significant only at the 10% level" =
    shrinks("APPLIED") && t3("APPLIED_EVER")$p < 0.1 && t3("APPLIED_EVER")$p >= 0.05,
  "the outcomes section's text on Table IV: ever assignment and enrollment through SUA fall, both statistically significant, by contrast with applications at the 5% level or below" =
    falls(t3s("ASSIGNED_EVER", "INSUA_EVER")) && all(t3s("ASSIGNED_EVER", "INSUA_EVER")$p < 0.05),
  "the outcomes section's text on Table IV: the eventual effect on enrollment outside SUA is not statistically significant" = null(t3s("OUTSIDE_EVER")),
  "the outcomes section's text on Table IV: the effects on graduation and application become smaller with follow-up, and assignment and enrollment through SUA remain lower" =
    shrinks("GRAD") && shrinks("APPLIED") && all(t3s("ASSIGNED_EVER", "INSUA_EVER")$est < 0),
  "a footnote of the outcomes section and the outcomes appendix's text on Table C.5: graduation, assignment and enrollment through SUA lower and statistically significant at both horizons" =
    falls(t5s("GRAD_OT", "GRAD_EVER", "ASSIGNED_OT", "ASSIGNED_EVER", "INSUA_OT", "INSUA_EVER")),
  "a footnote of the outcomes section and the outcomes appendix's text on Table C.5: the ever application effect is negative and statistically significant" = falls(t5s("APPLIED_EVER")),
  "a footnote of the outcomes section and the outcomes appendix's text on Table C.5: the effect on graduation through adult secondary education is statistically significant only at the eventual horizon" =
    null(t5s("GRAD_ADULT_OT")) && t5("GRAD_ADULT_EVER")$p < 0.1,
  "the outcomes section's and its appendix's text on the years: application years 2016-2021; the 2021 applicants' on-time and ever windows coincide; records through the 2025 school year and the 2026 process" =
    identical(years, "2016--2021") && identical(coincide, 2021L) && LAST_SCHOOL_YEAR == 2025L && LAST_COLLEGE_PROCESS == 2026L,
  "the outcomes appendix's text: the top-20% indicator is unavailable in the 2016 process" = identical(no_alto, 2016L),
  "the outcomes appendix's text: a student of the sample can belong to a rounded group labeled zero or one" = any(lottery$CHANCE_GROUP %in% c(0, 100)),
  "the outcomes appendix's text and Table C.5's note: the first-choice sample holds students inside and outside the lottery sample" =
    any(first_choice$LOTTERY_SAMPLE) && any(!first_choice$LOTTERY_SAMPLE),
  "a footnote of the outcomes section on the chance groups: the chance rounded to the hundredth takes all 101 possible values in the sample" =
    n_distinct(lottery$CHANCE_GROUP) == 101L
)
write.csv(claims, file.path(out_dir, "numbers", "outcomes_text_claims.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
message(sprintf("%d statements of the current text checked; %d do not hold with these results", nrow(claims), sum(!claims$holds)))
if (!all(claims$holds)) stop("statements of the current text that do not hold with these results: ", paste(claims$statement[!claims$holds], collapse = "; "))
as.data.frame(claims)
```

# Every estimate at full precision

Written to `numbers/outcomes_estimates.csv` under `out_dir` (17 significant digits), so that the tables can be checked against other
runs.

```{r estimates}
outcome_rows <- function(est, table, column) transmute(est, table = table, column = column, variable = var, est, se, p, n, mean)
estimates <- bind_rows(
  bind_rows(map2(est2, c("(2)", "(3)", "(4)"), function(e, k) mutate(e, table = "III", column = k, variable = rows2$var))),
  tibble(table = "III", column = "(1)", variable = rows2$var, mean = unname(mean2[rows2$var])),
  transmute(joint2, table = "III", column = c("(2)", "(3)", "(4)"), variable = "joint F", est = .data$F, p, n),
  mutate(fs3, table = "IV", column = "first stage", variable = "D_OD"),
  outcome_rows(est3, "IV", "2SLS"),
  transmute(col1, table = "C.2", column = "(1)", variable = var, est, se, n),
  transmute(col1, table = "C.2", column = "(2)", variable = var, mean = mean_all, n),
  transmute(col3, table = "C.2", column = "(3)", variable = var, mean = mean3, n = n3),
  transmute(est_c3, table = "C.3", column = "without the offer", variable = type, est = share, se, n),
  outcome_rows(est_c4, "C.4", "OLS"),
  mutate(fs_c5, table = "C.5", column = "first stage", variable = "D_OD"),
  outcome_rows(est_c5, "C.5", "2SLS"),
  tibble(table = "counts", column = "C.1", variable = names(funnel), est = unname(funnel)),
  tibble(table = "counts", column = "C.2 note", variable = names(c2_counts), est = unname(c2_counts)),
  tibble(table = "counts", column = "text", variable = names(counts), est = unname(counts)),
  tibble(table = "counts", column = "footnote", variable = names(footnote), est = unname(footnote))
) %>%
  select(table, column, variable, est, se, p, n, mean)
estimates %>%
  mutate(across(c(est, se, p, mean), function(x) sprintf("%.17g", x))) %>%
  write.csv(file.path(out_dir, "numbers", "outcomes_estimates.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
nrow(estimates)
```

Checks that this knit wrote every file listed here, and prints each with its bytes and MD5.

```{r outputs}
written <- c(file.path("tables", "results", c("lottery_balance.tex", "lottery_college.tex", "lottery_characteristics.tex", "lottery_college_offer.tex",
                                              "lottery_college_first_choice.tex")),
             file.path("tables", c("lottery_sample_construction.tex", "complier_alternatives.tex", "lottery_followup.tex", "outcomes_text_macros.tex")),
             file.path("numbers", c("outcomes_estimates.csv", "outcomes_text_numbers.csv", "outcomes_text_claims.csv")))
full <- file.path(out_dir, written)
stopifnot("every output was written by this knit" = all(file.exists(full)) && all(file.mtime(full) >= KNIT_START))
others <- setdiff(list.files(out_dir, recursive = TRUE), written)
if (length(others)) message("the output folder also holds files this knit did not write: ", paste(others, collapse = ", "))
data.frame(file = written, bytes = file.size(full), md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(full)))
```
